members.name: Dr. Ronaldo Laishram (PhD)
members.bio: Ronaldo Laishram is an astrophysicist, engineer, founder, discoverer, and science communicator who recently completed his PhD in Astronomy at Tohoku University, Japan. With a background in Computer Science Engineering, Ronaldo’s academic journey is distinguished by prestigious scholarships, including the Japanese Government MEXT Scholarship, Japan Science and Technology Fellowship, ILR etc, and is enriched by research experiences at institutions like Caltech, Northwestern University, Subaru Hawaii etc. He was also a Research Fellow at the Indian Space Research Organization and underwent training at various places both in India and abroad, such as Taiwan, Thailand, and Japan.Ronaldo is deeply committed to creating positive societal change through collaboration, believing that lasting impact is achievable only when individuals come together. He actively works to expand educational opportunities and provide resources for Manipur, embodying his vision of a society built on shared efforts and mutual support. Ronaldo believes that real change is only possible through collective action: “I cannot change society alone, and ‘YOU’ cannot do it alone, but together, I + YOU can make a difference.” Guided by this vision, he aspires to create a better society built on shared efforts by supporting underserved communities in Manipur.Balancing scientific inquiry with social responsibility, Ronaldo is dedicated to making a meaningful impact as both a researcher and a global citizen

members.name: Monendra Ningthoujam
members.bio: Monendra Ningthoujam is an ambitious and dedicated professional who graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from Manipur Technical University. Currently an engineer at Zeta, he has demonstrated his commitment to technological innovation through diverse experiences, including a prestigious internship at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore, under the Summer Research Fellowship (SRF) of the Indian Academy of Sciences, where he worked on machine learning-based wireless network propagation modeling, and an internship at Hexnbit Edtech Pvt. Ltd., Noida, where he honed his technical and problem-solving skills. As a long-standing member of MITSNA since 2019, he has contributed significantly to its initiatives, including the Rebuild Manipur project. Additionally, his volunteer work with the National Service Scheme reflects his passion for community service. Monendra exemplifies a well-rounded individual who blends technical expertise with a commitment to making a positive societal impact.

members.name: Rajkumar Narman Singh
members.bio: Rajkumar Narman Singh, a third-year Computer Science Engineering student at NIT Manipur, has a strong foundation in cybersecurity and a passion for space exploration. A former national table tennis player, he brings discipline and focus to every pursuit. As Mitsna’s Web Development Officer, he is dedicated to advancing our digital presence and creating impactful online experiences.
